violated_contract: A caller that treats a storage listing as the complete set of captured audio must receive either the complete listing or an error. A timed-out or failed sub-listing must never be dropped into a shorter or empty result, because the caller then admits, completes or disposes of a recording with audio silently missing.
canonical_prevention: Give the shared listing helper an explicit completeness mode that re-raises sub-listing failures, and have every completeness-critical caller (batch record admission and any terminal or partial decision) request it; best-effort readers such as playback and speaker sampling keep the degraded listing.
